definitions: Performed duties or services for (a person or organization).
Underwent a period of imprisonment or military service.
Was adequate or suitable for a purpose or need.
Delivered (a legal document) to the person concerned.
Hit (the ball) to start play in a game such as tennis or volleyball.
examples: He served his country for many years.
Dinner was served at eight o'clock.
The old car served its purpose well.
The summons was served on the defendant.
She served an ace in the final game.
